units.source_text: 接着话题又从七段夫人的娘家信州温泉浴场转到家庭问题。

en.t: Then the conversation shifted again from the hot spring resort in Shinshu, where the seventh dan player's wife had her family home, to household matters.

units.source_text: 大竹七段二十三岁就结婚，那时还是五段，

en.t: Otake, now a seventh dan, had married at twenty-three, when he was still a fifth dan,

units.source_text: 生了三个孩子，收了三个徒弟，全家共十口人。

en.t: and he had three children and three pupils, making ten people in the household altogether.
